$comment: What this SPA bundle needs from the native shell it runs inside. Read at build time by scripts/write-bundle-manifest.mjs and stamped into build/.virtues-bundle.json, which the box serves as GET /api/web-bundle/version. A shell whose COMMAND_SURFACE_VERSION (src-tauri/src/lib.rs) is lower than minShellVersion must REFUSE this bundle rather than load it and fail unpredictably. It is 9 because no shell below 9 can run a box bundle at all (every new chunk was served as text/html, so it booted white); those shells keep the UI they shipped with. Otherwise raise it only when the SPA genuinely cannot function on the older surface: raising it strands every client that has not updated its native app.
